translations.name: NJPCA community health center (FQHC) locator
translations.description: Use the NJPCA locator to find a community health center (FQHC) near you. Health centers serve you no matter what you can pay. A sliding fee lowers your cost instead of denying care. The locator is online 24/7.
translations.website_description: Learn about free or low-cost health care.
